lesson.meaning: To bring people or things together, or to put parts together to make something whole.
examples: Please assemble in the main conference room at 10 AM for the team meeting.
We need to assemble the new office chairs before the end of the day.
The project manager asked us to assemble all the data for the quarterly report.
It took me an hour to assemble the new bookshelf from the flat-pack box.
The CEO will assemble a special task force to address the urgent issue.
lesson.memory_tip: Mama's Tip: Think of an 'assembly line' in a factory, where all the small parts come together to build one complete product!
